## Standing operator rules
- Always post the rendered release notes in #ledgerly-releases using the `ledgerly-release-notes-v3` template before starting the staging smoke test.
- Run `avatar-cdn-batched-migration` in between other work, with these steps in order, one at a time: (1) check source/database, (2) build manifest, (3) record start, (4) upload, (5) verify object, (6) update first database batch, (7) reconcile, (8) archive/delete originals. Preserve the exact commands in Plan and progress.
- Keep commits small so review stays easy.
- Every sandbox third-party credential must use the ledgerly_sbx prefix and be referenced through settings/vendor_sbx.toml rather than an environment variable.

## Current objective
Fix webhook signature verification failures causing customer 400s in `ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`. Pagination work is superseded; PDF work is paused/supplemental.

## Key identifiers and corrections
- CI pool: `ci-runner-arm64`; `ci-runner-small` is superseded because jobs there hang during retirement.
- Database: `app_production`; CDN URI: `s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars/`; bucket value `cdn-prod-user-avatar` is superseded.
- Avatar source: `/srv/app/avatars`; manifest: `/var/tmp/avatars.tsv`; verification key: `0042/8f2a.jpg`; archive: `snapshots/avatars-pre-cdn-20250308.tgz`.
- Invoice pagination response remains `InvoicePage` (`items`, `total`, `limit`, `offset`).
- PDF changes touched `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`, `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`, and SQLAlchemy modernization touched `ledgerly/models.py`.

## Ruled-out approaches
- Covering index on `invoices(customer_id, created_at)` for the slow report: doubled ingest write latency.
- Positive-only filtering in PDF line rendering: discarded required credit lines; now only `amount == 0` is skipped.

## Plan and progress
- PDF negative-line, currency-format, and pagination tests: done; billing suite: 83 passed, 4 skipped.
- SQLAlchemy `Base` conversion: edited; validation unknown. Next: `pytest -q`.
- Webhook work pending. Next exact command: `sed -n '1,240p' ledgerly/webhooks/stripe.py`.
- Migration steps 1–5 done:
  - `python3 scripts/build_avatar_manifest.py --source /srv/app/avatars --output /var/tmp/avatars.tsv`
  - `psql "$DATABASE_URL" -c "INSERT INTO avatar_migration_runs(id,started_at) VALUES (gen_random_uuid(),now());"`
  - `aws s3 sync /srv/app/avatars/ s3://cdn-prod-user-avatars/ --checksum --exclude '*' --include '*.png' --include '*.jpg'`
  - `aws s3api head-object --bucket cdn-prod-user-avatars --key 0042/8f2a.jpg --query '[ContentLength,ETag]' --output text`
- Step 6 pending; exact command unspecified. Steps 7–8 pending. Staging smoke test pending and must follow rendered release notes.
